saw_lines: Meat buyers pick a cut and a source, then reorder the same box on a schedule once it tastes right.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a new buyer decides whether a scheduled box is worth trying.
Your 14 ads mostly skip the subscribe offer, only 1 of 14 mentions it, so put subscribe and save in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 11 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers Subscribe and Save, yet only 1 of 14 ads mentions it. New buyers get no reason to start a recurring box. Put the offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

Your site explains how the order ships and why the meat is vacuum sealed, yet 0 of 14 ads say how it arrives, so buyers hesitate. Shoot one video of the box arriving and opening, with the vacuum sealed bags inside.
One exact copy runs in 5 of 14 ads, so the same buyers see the same message over and over and tune it out. Keep the body copy, but change the opening line and creative in each of the five ads.
None of your 14 ads carries a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing concrete to trust before clicking. Collect one real number, such as orders shipped, and open the next three ads with it.

ads_1: Subscribe-led creative showing the box arriving, opening on the pasture-raised cut
